narrative.overview: The site reads like a tide calendar pinned to a navy wall. Every page sits on a drenched navy ground that deepens section by section, and every fact is a ruled row with a hairline gold rule. Gold is the sun on that water: headings, numerals, rules and the single action color. Sand paper appears only where data must be read as data.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-drenched pages stepping darker or lighter per section.
Facts in hairline-ruled rows, not icon-card grids.
One action color (gold-300) with navy-950 text.
Square corners, no shadows, no nested cards.
Sand panels only for tabular or numeric data.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-The-Sun Rule
rules.body: Gold carries headings, numbers, rules and the one action. Never use it as a large fill other than the button.

rules.name: The Sand-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Sand surfaces hold only ruled data (schedules, prices). Prose and imagery stay on navy.

rules.name: The Narrow Caps Rule
rules.body: Archivo narrow uppercase is for headings and row keys only; running text never uses it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any figure that sits in a column or row uses Inter with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-Tide Rule
rules.body: Separate with a hairline or a tonal step, never a shadow or a card within a card.

dos: Do present facts as hairline-ruled key/value rows with Archivo narrow caps keys.
Do put the dark ground under every section and step navy-950, 900, 800 for rhythm.
Do use gold-300 for headings, numerals, and the one action; navy-950 text on gold.
Do use Inter tabular-nums for every price, percentage and year figure.
Do keep corners square and depth tonal.
Do keep disclaimers (reference price, non-guaranteed revenue) in 14px navy-100 beneath the data they qualify.
donts: Don't put icon-card grids or oversized stat strips where a ruled row would do.
Don't use sand surfaces for prose or imagery.
Don't add shadows, rounded cards, nested cards, or decorative gradients.
Don't put gold body text on sand; use burnt gold (gold-900) there.
Don't set Archivo narrow caps on running text.
